recommendation.message: Simulated observations cannot produce a final live recommendation.

limitations: Qualification also requires the operational reliability lower bound to meet the threshold; completed workflows remain separately visible when cleanup or persistence fails.
Browser-only rankings measure observable workflow completion. Any independently verified provider observations remain separate from that primary outcome.
Missing cost inputs remain unknown and cannot support a cost advantage claim.
All planned logical sessions, including infrastructure failures and cancellations, stay in operational denominators; retries never add samples.

methodology.cluster_interval: Whole-cluster percentile bootstrap with effective-cluster Wilson boundary envelope
methodology.pairwise: Matched-stratum tests; Holm correction across all reported run tests
methodology.reproduction: Create a separate batch using the pinned target/workflow versions, adapter distribution, seed and proxy policy; restore compatible profile generations and record new trial identities. Never overwrite this snapshot.

limitations: Different targets, workflow versions, environments, evidence modes, phases, thresholds and cost currencies are never pooled.
